 Cancer Shani Horoscope Today, 7 November 2026: Moon Sextile Mars Gives Work Energy, Shani Keeps It Controlled 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Cancer Shani Horoscope Today, 7 November 2026: Moon Sextile Mars Gives Work Energy, Shani Keeps It Controlled 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 07, 2026, 02:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print A burst of focus arrives for Cancer this Saturday. The Moon, your ruling planet, travels through Virgo, your third house of effort and initiative. By evening, it forms a sextile with Mars in your own sign. Mars is your yogakaraka, ruling the fifth and tenth houses, so this link fuels career drive and practical courage. Pending work before Diwali can move quickly today. Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your ninth, adds a steady hand so speed doesn't turn into carelessness. Moon Sextile Mars
 Mars sits weak in Cancer, yet a friendly angle from the Moon lifts its energy. You may feel ready to finish reports, close a sale or clear your desk before the holiday. Calls you were avoiding can be made with confidence. Use the first half of the day for the toughest task. Energy will be strongest then. Shani Keeps the Pace Measured
 On Shanivar, Shani’s influence is stronger than usual. Its seventh aspect falls on Virgo, where the Moon passes today. So while motivation runs high, Shani wants accuracy. Double-check numbers, names and dates before sending anything. Shani’s tenth aspect from Pisces lands on Sagittarius, the house of daily duties and competition in your chart. A colleague may push you to rush. Work at your own steady speed instead. Festival and Workload
 Today is Narak Chaturdashi, and many households also mark Hanuman Jayanti. If you are working, keep festival plans simple. A short evening prayer to Hanuman, known for tireless service, suits your mood. Planets in the Fourth
 The Sun, now in Vishakha, sits in Libra, your fourth, with retrograde Mercury and Venus. Family may want your help at home while you are busy with work. Set a clear time to switch off from office matters. Jupiter and Ketu in Leo, your second, support careful spending during the festival. Do’s for Today
 Finish the hardest task before lunch.
 Recheck figures and names in your work.
 Set a fixed time to stop working tonight.
 Don’ts for Today
 Do not rush because a colleague insists.
 Avoid taking on new tasks before Diwali.
 Skip working late into the festival night.
 Shani Remedy for Today
 Give a lunch packet to a street sweeper working through the festival. Offer black sesame and jaggery at a Hanuman temple.
